governing_law.instructions: Identify the governing law / choice of law jurisdiction stated in the contract (usually in a 'Governing Law' clause).

criteria.delaware: Contract is governed by Delaware law
criteria.new_york: Contract is governed by New York law
criteria.california: Contract is governed by California law
criteria.other_us_state: Contract is governed by a US state other than the above
criteria.england_and_wales: Contract is governed by the law of England and Wales
criteria.ireland: Contract is governed by Irish law
criteria.singapore: Contract is governed by Singapore law
criteria.other_international: Contract is governed by a non-US jurisdiction other than the above
criteria.not_specified: No governing law clause is present

indemnity_scope.instructions: Characterize the scope of the indemnification clause(s).

criteria.ip_infringement_only: Indemnity is limited to IP infringement claims
criteria.mutual_general: Both parties indemnify each other for general third-party claims
criteria.one_sided_vendor_favorable: Only customer indemnifies vendor, or vendor's obligations are narrowly carved out
criteria.one_sided_customer_favorable: Only vendor indemnifies customer, or customer's obligations are narrowly carved out
criteria.broad_unlimited: Indemnity obligations are broad, covering most claims, without a liability cap carve-out

dispute_resolution_method.instructions: Identify how disputes arising under the contract must be resolved.

criteria.litigation_courts: Disputes are resolved through court litigation
criteria.binding_arbitration: Disputes must go to binding arbitration
criteria.non_binding_arbitration: Disputes must go to non-binding arbitration
criteria.mediation_then_arbitration: Contract requires mediation as a precondition to arbitration
criteria.not_specified: No dispute resolution mechanism is specified

ip_ownership.instructions: Determine who owns intellectual property in deliverables or work product created under the contract.

criteria.customer_owns_deliverables: Customer owns all IP in deliverables
criteria.vendor_owns_deliverables: Vendor retains ownership and grants customer a license
criteria.joint_ownership: IP is jointly owned by both parties
criteria.license_only_no_transfer: No ownership transfers; only usage rights are licensed

renewal_notice_period_band.instructions: How much advance written notice must a party give to prevent auto-renewal or non-renewal of the contract?

liability_cap_amount_band.instructions: What is the aggregate liability cap amount, expressed as a multiple of fees paid/payable under the contract (e.g. 12 months of fees)?

termination_notice_period_band.instructions: For termination for convenience, how much advance written notice is required?

cure_period_band.instructions: For termination for cause / material breach, how long does the breaching party have to cure before termination is effective?

payment_terms_band.instructions: What are the invoice payment terms (days from invoice to payment due)?

confidentiality_term_band.instructions: How long do confidentiality obligations survive after termination or expiration of the contract?

auto_renewal.instructions: Does the contract automatically renew for an additional term unless a party affirmatively opts out?

criteria.true: Contract contains an evergreen / auto-renewal clause
criteria.false: Contract has a fixed term with no auto-renewal, or renewal requires affirmative action by both parties

liability_cap_present.instructions: Does the contract contain a clause limiting a party's aggregate liability to a stated amount?

criteria.true: An explicit liability cap or limitation-of-liability amount is stated
criteria.false: No liability cap is stated, or liability is expressly uncapped

liability_cap_mutual.instructions: If a liability cap exists, does it apply equally to both parties (mutual) rather than only to one party?

criteria.true: The liability cap applies mutually to both parties
criteria.false: The liability cap is one-sided, or there is no liability cap

indemnity_mutual.instructions: Are the indemnification obligations mutual, i.e. do both parties indemnify each other on substantially similar terms?

criteria.true: Both parties owe each other indemnification obligations
criteria.false: Indemnification runs in one direction only, or there is none

data_processing_terms_present.instructions: Does the contract include data processing terms (e.g. a DPA, or data protection/privacy obligations covering personal data handling)?

criteria.true: Data processing / data protection terms are present, whether inline or as an attached DPA
criteria.false: No data processing terms are present

data_breach_notification_present.instructions: Does the contract require the vendor to notify the customer of a security or data breach, and if so within a defined timeframe?

criteria.true: A breach notification obligation is stated
criteria.false: No breach notification obligation is stated

termination_for_convenience.instructions: May either party terminate the contract for convenience (without cause), subject only to a notice period?

criteria.true: At least one party may terminate for convenience
criteria.false: Contract may only be terminated for cause/breach, or is non-terminable before term end

late_payment_penalty_present.instructions: Does the contract impose a late fee, interest charge, or other penalty for overdue payments?

criteria.true: A late payment penalty or interest charge is specified
criteria.false: No late payment penalty is specified

assignment_restriction.instructions: Does the contract restrict either party's ability to assign the agreement without the other party's consent?

criteria.true: Assignment requires prior consent or is otherwise restricted
criteria.false: Assignment is unrestricted or the contract is silent on assignment

exclusivity_clause.instructions: Does the contract grant exclusivity (e.g. sole-source, exclusive territory, or exclusive supplier/customer rights) to either party?

criteria.true: An exclusivity obligation or right is present
criteria.false: No exclusivity obligation or right is present

most_favored_nation_clause.instructions: Does the contract include a most-favored-nation / most-favored-customer pricing clause?

criteria.true: An MFN-style pricing clause is present
criteria.false: No MFN-style pricing clause is present

non_compete_clause.instructions: Does the contract include a non-compete restriction on either party?

warranty_disclaimer_present.instructions: Does the contract disclaim implied warranties (e.g. 'AS IS', merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose)?

criteria.false: No warranty disclaimer is present, or warranties are affirmatively made without disclaimer

force_majeure_clause.instructions: Does the contract include a force majeure clause excusing performance for events outside a party's control?

criteria.true: A force majeure clause is present
criteria.false: No force majeure clause is present

audit_rights_present.instructions: Does the contract grant either party the right to audit the other's records, security controls, or compliance (e.g. SOC 2, invoicing)?

criteria.true: An audit right is granted to at least one party
